name: Ibiza Town Christmas market
when: Late November to 6 January, daily from 11:00
desc: Stalls down the boulevard under the big tree: crafts, jewellery, leather, decorations, with a Mercat Gastronòmic of food stalls and live music alongside, Papa Noel's hut for the kids on December weekends and the funfair at Sa Joveria. Last year it opened 29 November; 2026 dates as soon as the town hall publishes them.

name: Santa Eulària Christmas market
when: Early December to 5 January · Mon–Sat 10:30–13:30 & 16:30–20:00, Sun mornings
village: Rambla & Passeig de s'Alamera, Santa Eulària
desc: The gentlest of the Christmas markets: handmade crafts and seasonal decorations along the paseo, lights in the palms, the town's own programme of concerts and workshops around it.

name: Sant Antoni Christmas market
when: From 1 December · weekday evenings, all day Fri–Sun
desc: Gifts, decorations, food and drink stalls, a children's fair and live shows on the square by the egg. The most family-friendly of the four.

name: Las Dalias Christmas market
desc: Forty-odd decorated stalls under the trees — clothes, soaps, liqueurs, jewellery, leather — plus mulled wine and warm food. The hippy market in its Christmas jumper.
